what: Twelve file-folder tab cards share the row width equally and sit overlapped toward the right. Hovering a card other than the front one unfolds it fully while the rest fold down to just the tab strip (3.75rem) — the left margin changes with .4s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1). On release, all return to their places

options.--fx-strip: Width of the strip a folded section leaves behind, default 3.75rem
options.--fx-dur / --fx-ease: Opening length and curve, default .4s · cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards (direct children, several) — supplied by the side that uses z-index so the front card sits on top

use:
Card 1
Card 2
Card 3
note: No expansion on touch devices — on phones the original turns the cards into a horizontally swipeable strip (the user’s css)

from.where: index.js·index.css .h-fan (business tab, fan of 12 cards) — original .card_container .card: margin-left calc(-20rem + (100% − 20rem) / 11), folded −16.25rem, transition margin .4s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)
